name: iter_broad
description: The broad screening sweep for the iterative study, the analogue of the companion paper's 324,000-configuration grid but restricted to the axes the loop makes newly meaningful. Crosses trajectory length, the two coverage controls and their schedules, the learning-rate schedule, the architecture and the retraining budget, at the paper's operating point for everything else. Intended as the sensitivity map that fixes the iterative operating point before the single-axis configs isolate each dimension. Accumulative regime only and 3 seeds to keep it affordable — 2x3x3x2x3x3x3x3 = 2,916 configs x 3 seeds; run it on a many-core machine with the parallel option on.
